# secureaccess_regions (Data Source)

This data source can read the regions available for Network Tunnel Groups, together with the BGP peer information of the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_regions" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bgp_as_number` (String) BGP autonomous system (AS) number of Secure Access.
- `bgp_peer_ips` (List of String) BGP peer IP addresses of Secure Access.
- `bgp_peer_range` (String) BGP peer IP range of Secure Access.
- `regions` (Attributes List) List of available regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `continent` (String) Continent of the region.
- `description` (String) Description of the region.
- `name` (String) Display name of the region.
- `region` (String) Region identifier, used as the `region` of a Network Tunnel Group.
